name: Marlowe's Barbers
summary: A cluttered one-page site with tiny text became a sharp four-page site with prices, opening hours and a call button that is always in reach.

name: The Daily Crumb
summary: The old site hid the menu in a PDF that was painful to open on a phone. The new one puts the menu, opening times and directions a tap away.
highlights: Menu you can read on a phone

name: St Aldhelm's Church
summary: Years of notices had buried the one thing newcomers want to know: when is the service? The redesign leads with a welcome and this week's times.
highlights: Easy for volunteers to keep current
